data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter static analysis and lint rules incorporated in Mews.
data.what_it_does: Provides a sample analysis_options.yaml file containing specific lint rules and static analysis configuration used by Mews. It is based on flutter_lints.
use_when: You want to enforce Mews coding standards and static analysis rules in your Dart or Flutter project
You want a pre-configured set of lint rules based on flutter_lints
avoid_when: You prefer standard default lints or a different custom linting setup
strengths: Standardizes lint rules across projects using Mews configurations
Easy to integrate by including the configuration in analysis_options.yaml
weaknesses: Frequent breaking changes due to upgrades of underlying tools like DCM
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency in pubspec.yaml and include package:mews_pedantic/analysis_options.yaml in your analysis_options.yaml file.
